# sreagent_alert_mutes (Data Source)

Every alert_mute row, read-only. Silences alerts matching a pattern. Rows cannot be edited, so any change replaces the mute.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sreagent_alert_mutes" "all" {}

output "alert_mutes_count" {
  value = length(data.sreagent_alert_mutes.all.items)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The resource key the list was read from.
- `items` (Attributes List) The rows. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))
- `truncated` (Boolean) True when the API returned as many rows as its cap and may hold more.

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `created_via` (String) Which door created it.
- `ends_at` (String) When the mute stops silencing.
- `id` (String) The row's identifier on the platform.
- `pattern` (String) The substring to silence, 2 to 200 characters, matched without case and stored lowercased.
- `reason` (String) Why it is muted.
